title: Matrix
description: Audience portraits reconstructed as emerald terminal characters, falling code and music-driven digital scans.

parameters.label: Presence
parameters.description: How strongly the audience resolves and expands within the code field.

parameters.label: Code Rain
parameters.description: Density and length of falling code trails.

parameters.label: Displace
parameters.description: Local column offsets split and reassemble the audience.

parameters.label: Scan
parameters.description: A bright scan region resolves the audience through the code.

parameters.label: Code Detail
parameters.description: More rows produce smaller, finer characters.

parameters.label: Pace
parameters.description: Continuous downward travel of the character columns.

parameters.label: Highlights
parameters.description: Pale green character highlights in the audience, column heads and scan regions.

parameters.label: Code Color
parameters.description: Color of the audience code field.

parameters.label: Effect
parameters.description: Overall reconstruction of the input image into code.

provenance.prompt_summary: Bundled Matrix revision: approved audience reconstruction and independent musical actions.
